observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: An outdoor stage at night during a public cultural festival.
observation.dancers: A group of male dancers, approximately 10 to 12 performers.
observation.formation_and_space: A single horizontal line across the stage, performing synchronized choreography and moving forward and backward.
observation.posture: Upright torsos with deep knee bends, body shifting weight dynamically to match drum beats.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and leaping patterns matching the beat, lifting knees high and stamping on the stage floor.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out or raised, some dancers holding small cymbals or vessels while two drummers play large drums hung from their necks.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torsos remain relatively upright while bending at the knees and hips during leaps and dips.
observation.partnering: None, performed as a group ensemble.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low squats and high leaping jumps on the spot and traveling.
observation.costume_and_props: Colorful traditional attire consisting of yellow and blue dhotis, red shirts, ornate headgear with feather or plume crests, and large barrel drums with painted faces played by some performers.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and intricate weight transfers are partially obscured by distance and stage lighting.

signature_moments.what: The group forms a line and performs synchronized synchronized high jumps while drumming.
Dancers alternate deep knee dips with rapid stamping footwork in unison.
Dancers leap sideways while striking rhythmic poses with their arms.
